landscapeBanner: Turn your device sideways for a better view
pickUpHint: Nothing in your hand beats the pile
ruleLine: Phase 1: a two-player duel, suit irrelevant, higher card takes both / Phase 2: beat the pile (higher of the same suit, or a trump)
tutorial.beat: In phase two you must beat the pile. Ducking with a weak card is not allowed; if you cannot beat it, you pick the pile up.
tutorial.collected: Collected counts are public. What you collect becomes your phase-two hand, so winning too much is a liability.
tutorial.duel: Phase one is always a two-player duel. Suit is irrelevant -- the higher card takes both, and its owner leads next.
tutorial.phases: This game is made of two phases that are different games: first you collect cards, then you shed the cards you collected.
tutorial.stunsa: Equal ranks are a stunsa: the cards stay on the table, the same player leads again, and whoever settles it takes everything that piled up.
